_comment: Mario's name for each shipped picture -- the reveal on the win screen, and the answer to the puzzle, which is why the picker and the board never show it. Keys are the puzzle's identity: its name in janko.txt ('JANKO222') or the bare janko id that name ends in ('222'). A bank index is NEVER a key -- the bank is emitted size-sorted and renumbers on any change, so an index names a different picture after any edit. Values are uppercase, at most 9 characters, and may use only A-Z, digits, space, hyphen and apostrophe: the display cut has no fallback box, so a glyph it lacks is a hole in the word rather than a box, and gen_picross.py refuses the file rather than shipping one. A puzzle with no entry here is simply unnamed, and its win screen draws no name band. Drop the namer's output in over this file and run tools_local/picross/gen_picross.py.
